_comment: Narration voices for `manim-kit render --voice` and `manim-kit voice say`.
Text only: the Kokoro model files are fetched into ~/.cache/manim-kit/voices/
by `manim-kit voice setup` and checked against the sha256 below, never committed.
A spec string is 'backend:voice' or 'backend:voice:lang'. The default below is
fleet-wide, because this repo is synced to every host. $MANIM_KIT_VOICE overrides
it per host or per shell, and `--voice SPEC` overrides both.
Two backends in this version (user decision 2026-09-17): kokoro-v1 runs offline on
the CPU and is the default; gemini-flash-tts calls the API, costs money and has the
better prosody plus real German. Piper, gTTS and edge-tts stay out - see
Gemini billing: $1 per 1M input text tokens plus $20 per 1M audio output tokens,
about $0.006 for a two-sentence narration line.

kokoro-v1.label: Kokoro v1.0 (kokoro-onnx)
kokoro-v1.note: Offline. About 0.4x real time on a 12-thread laptop, so 10 minutes of narration takes 4 minutes.

gemini-flash-tts.label: Gemini TTS
gemini-flash-tts.note: 24 kHz PCM. Needs GEMINI_API_KEY. A leading instruction sentence is read as a directive, not spoken.

voices.note: Default. Even, unhurried American female voice - the one to explain maths with.
Warmer American female voice, a little more expressive than af_sarah.
American male voice, the clearest of the male Kokoro set.
Lively male voice. Best prosody of the English options, and it costs money.
Calm female voice, good for a long explainer.
German female voice. There is no offline German option in this version.
